brand.name: Hamper'd

brand.hq: 1100 North Raleigh Blvd, Suite 143, Raleigh NC 27610
brand.voice: Punchy, warm, benefit-first. Short sentences. Local pride. Never hype-y filler. Sign-off: The Hamper'd Team.

cadence.note: 7:00am ET daily scan; Monday 8:00am ET episode. Cron stored in UTC (EDT=UTC-4). Shift to 12:00/13:00 UTC during EST.

episode.intro_line: From the Hamper'd News Desk in Raleigh…
episode.outro_line: Go live it up, Raleigh — the laundry's on us. Hamperd dot com.

verification.confirmed_rule: (official organizer/venue/ticketing source AND future date AND Raleigh-area venue) OR two independent sources that agree on date+venue
verification.handle_check: Every tagged Instagram handle must be resolved from an official source before it goes in a caption.

targets: public Instagram/Facebook pages of Raleigh venues, breweries, coffee shops, run clubs — best effort, no login
new restaurant/bar/coffee openings — Axios Raleigh openings, Triangle Business Journal, Raleigh Magazine food news
